## Lineage
A cadet line of the Piasts, small, proud and squeezed between the Order, Poland and Lithuania. **Janusz I** (c. 1346–1429) married [Danutė](../characters/danute.qmd) Kęstutaitė, and his brother **Siemowit IV** (c. 1352–1426) married Aleksandra Algirdaitė in 1387, so the two brothers married both Gediminid lines. **Henryk**, bishop-elect of Płock, married Rimgailė Kęstutaitė in 1392 and was dead within a year. [Record; details marked verify in the world bible]

## Feuds & alliances
Steady allies of [Vytautas](../characters/vytautas.qmd) through Janusz. Siemowit was a failed candidate for the Polish crown in 1382–84, which makes him a quiet rival of Jogaila; Henryk carried Jogaila's offer to Vytautas before [Ostrów](../events/ev_ostrow.qmd) (1392). The Order's borders press on the duchy from the north.

## Fate across the books
- **I:** after the [escape from Krėva](../events/ev_kreva_escape.qmd), Vytautas runs first to Janusz and Danutė in Masovia ([the refuge](../events/ev_masovia_refuge.qmd)). **II:** Henryk's embassy opens the road to Ostrów.
- **III–IV:** the duchy stays between the two powers; Danutė outlives her brother's era in the record.
- **V:** the Masovian dukes remain neighbours at the edge of the cousins' war. [Saga, minor]
